conclusion.body:
## Episode conclusion (advisory, not acceptance)

Intent: DELIVER
Statement: Delivered the Fleet correction as direct committed revision 95b83e7: a zero or omitted StreamReadings limit now returns the first three available readings in source order, while positive limits, GetReading, unknown-site errors, field numbers and REST behavior are unchanged. MIGRATION.md records the correction and explains that the released proto comment is stale and intentionally untouched; the protocol, codec, client and REST test files are byte-for-byte unchanged. The committed revision passes the full node --test suite (18/18). This is an advisory direct deliverable, not a governed result, canonical-head advance, or release acceptance; release approval belongs to the owner.
Artifacts:
- service/grpc_server.js
- test/integration.test.js
- test/server.test.js
- MIGRATION.md
Waiting on: (none)
